description: Parsed SEC Form 4 insider filings for a company: insider name and role (director, officer title, 10% owner), transaction code (open-market buy/sell, award, exercise, tax withholding...), shares, price, USD value, holdings after, 10b5-1 plan flag, plus a buy/sell summary. You only pay for successful reads: invalid input, not-found and upstream errors cancel settlement. ($0.005 USDC on Base)

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193 (alternative to ticker).

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. AAPL or BRK.B. Provide ticker or cik.

name: company_insider_trades
